links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified AAPOS patient education materials (111 PEMs)
links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, FKGL) and PEMAT understandability of patient education materials
links.effect: Baseline PEMs averaged a 9th-grade level (SMOG 9.0 ± 1.6; FKGL 9.6 ± 2.1), with 3.6% meeting the 6th-grade recommendation. ChatGPT-4 rewrites reached a 7th-grade level and Gemini Advanced rewrites met the 6th-grade threshold. Understandability was 90.9% (ChatGPT-4) and 91.3% (Gemini Advanced), P < 0.001. Rewrites contained no misinformation (Likert = 1).
links.tradeoff: Gemini Advanced rewrites showed modestly reduced quality (DISCERN: 3; P < 0.001). The authors advise physician review of PEMs for safety.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 rewrites improved readability to a 7th-grade level without compromising quality, while Gemini Advanced rewrites met the 6th-grade threshold but showed modestly reduced quality (DISCERN: 3; P < 0.001).

design_hint: reading-level simplification of patient education materials by LLM rewriting
